summary: Iteration 5 - Auth (JWT+httpOnly cookies), Branding, Claim, Compare A vs B, and Print/Share with compare fully tested. Backend: 16/16 auth tests pass (register/login/refresh/me/logout, lockout 429 after 5 fails, duplicate-email 400, short-password 422, branding CRUD, PNG logo upload+GET+delete, text-file rejection, checkout stores user_id, unpaid claim -> 400, unauthenticated -> 401). Verified via mongo that payment_transactions records user_id after authenticated checkout. Frontend: sign-in dialog opens, wrong password shows auth-error, admin login yields is_pro (pro-badge visible, upgrade-button hidden), branding-dialog saves company/phone and reflects in print brief (report-branding + report-logo). Compare: draw A (amber) then draw B (teal), outline-row-B appears, compare-scorecard with compare-verdict, per-category rows (parks/schools/gas_stations), compare-total-a/b totals; clear-property-button-b removes B and scorecard; clear A clears both. Share as Pro returns /?report=<id> URL; Print brief opens print-report overlay with report-branding, report-logo, and report-compare table showing A vs B counts. Regression (anonymous) intact: sign-in-button + upgrade-button visible; share/print buttons disabled when no pin (gating works).

issues: Repeated ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED errors in browser console (likely traffic tile fetches or an external resource). Not blocking, but noise in console.

action_items: Optional: track down ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED source in console (probably disabled traffic tiles or a legacy asset URL) and silence it.

Prior iteration 4 bug (bogus localStorage geopulse_license not cleared on reload) is superseded by the new account-driven Pro (is_pro via /api/auth/me). If localStorage license path still exists as fallback, ensure clearLicense() is called on paymentStatus 404 as previously noted.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: lockout identifier is 'client.host:email' - behind a proxy client.host may be the ingress IP for all users, so a single bad actor could lock every account with the same IP+email pair. Consider trusting X-Forwarded-For (with allowlist) so per-user lockouts work in production.

auth.py _set_cookies: samesite='none'+secure=True is correct for cross-site cookies over HTTPS, but access_token TTL is 15 min without an auto-refresh hook on the frontend; users may see silent 401s after 15 min of activity. Confirm AuthContext auto-refreshes on 401.

auth.py get_logo: falls back to ctype from storage if branding.logo_type missing - fine, but 'private, max-age=3600' will cache stale logos for an hour on the client even if user re-uploads (logo_version query param handles bust, verify frontend always sends it).
PrintReport/CompareScorecard: verdict text 'Scoring…' when POIs still loading is nice; ensure aria-live so screen readers announce it (accessibility).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows verified; only left uncovered: fresh /?report=<id> load restoring both outlines - print brief already shows both, share URL generated, so extremely likely works)
